name: Rubinacci
why: Naples' aristocratic tailoring house — three generations of drape.
origin: Gennaro Rubinacci, Naples, 1932 — named his tailoring house 'London House' and softened English cloth into Neapolitan drape.
opview: Positions Neapolitan drape as an aristocratic inheritance.

onething.n: Use; https://www.marianorubinacci.com/en/collection/trousers/green-linen-manny-trousers-MANNYL-A2566/ and call them manny trousers

notes.wool: Neapolitan drape from the London House lineage
notes.ital: London House in Naples, and the family's claim to have shaped the Neapolitan shoulder. The archive of vintage cloth is the house's real inheritance.
notes.boat: Coastal by geography rather than by design intent. The Neapolitan house sits on the water and always has.

marks: Loro Piana Storm System (spelled ""Storm Sistem"" on site) - LICENSED (standing rule: Loro Piana mark on a house that is not Loro Piana)
